name: A startled imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, a sack of glittering diamonds slung on its shoulder, eyes bulging in alarm, scrambling to get away

poses.stand: scrambling upward in the air on frantic bat wings, eyes bulging, the sack slung on its shoulder
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: flaps frantically in place, looking around in alarm

move.action: scrambles frantically up and away, wings flapping wildly, looking back in alarm, staying in the same spot in the frame

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
